title: Fasset Hits $1B Valuation With $68M SBI Round to Scale Global Stablecoin Payments
summary:
Key Takeaways: Fasset has raised $68M through a Series C round of funding led by Japan’s SBI Group. The round estimates the value of the stablecoin fintech at $1B. Fasset
The post Fasset Hits $1B Valuation With $68M SBI Round to Scale Global Stablecoin Payments appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Fasset has raised $68M through a Series C round of funding led by Japan’s SBI Group.
  • The round estimates the value of the stablecoin fintech at $1B.
  • Fasset does $40B+ in annualized volume, spread across 125 countries.

Fasset has attracted new investors to continue to develop its financial infrastructure based on crypto-compliant money in emerging markets. The investment in the $68 million Series C, led by SBI Group, is currently valued at $1 billion for the crypto fintech, making its total funding for the year of $119 million.

  • Fasset Secures $68M Series C
  • Stablecoins Sit Behind Fasset’s Payment Network
    • Own Network Expands Global Crypto Rails
    • SBI Deepens Its Crypto Push

Fasset Secures $68M Series C

The latest round comes after Fasset’s $51 million raise in May, which was the last major capital injection in a span of a few months.

CEO and co-founder Mohammad Raafi Hossain said the company was built around the idea that access to financial opportunities should not depend on geography. Fasset is targeting markets where cross-border payments and access to global financial services remain costly or fragmented.

Opportunity shouldn’t depend on where you were born or where you can go. Opportunity should be accessible to all.

That belief is why we started Fasset. And that is why we chose to build from emerging markets, where the problem is often felt the hardest.

Today, we’re announcing…

— Mohammad Raafi Hossain (@RaafiHossain) August 24, 2026

Its platform now facilitates the processing of over $40 billion in transactions annually in 125 countries, the company says.

Fasset also said the business is doing well, with Hossain stating that revenue is up about sixfold year over year. He said it has been profitable for 12 months, but Fasset hasn’t publicized detailed revenue or profit measures.

Read More: SBI Targets $6T On-Chain Finance Market With Canton Network Expansion and New Digital Unit

Stablecoins Sit Behind Fasset’s Payment Network

Fasset’s financial products utilize stablecoins in connection with settlement infrastructure. While stablecoins do the heavy lifting, users can seamlessly switch between bank accounts, currencies, payment products, and other assets.

It’s designed for cross-border payments, where it can have several intermediaries and require multiple transactions in different currencies.

Own Network Expands Global Crypto Rails

Fasset is the founder of Own Network – an Ethereum Layer 2 with Arbitrum technology. It links up over 100 banking corridors with banks, payment companies, telecom companies and liquidity providers.

The agreement will raise the firm’s capital so that it can invest in the infrastructure and AI-powered transaction routing capabilities. These systems are designed to determine payment routes, currencies, liquidity sources, and settlement methods based on a variety of criteria, including costs, speed, and availability.

The strategy’s core focus is the stablecoin as a central component of Fasset’s payments platform and not as just a crypto asset for trading or transferring.

SBI Deepens Its Crypto Push

SBI Group’s investment helps it tie up Fasset and access one of Japan’s largest financial groups.

SBI has been building on its crypto mix with investments and partnerships in various cryptocurrency businesses, payment and blockchain-native firms. It owns shares in Ripple, Circle and crypto liquidity provider B2C2.

Fasset has additionally collaborated with SBI Remit regarding the stablecoin cross-border payment obstructions. The collaboration seeks to bridge the connection of remittance systems and blockchain systems in the settlement process.

With the new funding, Fasset will go big on payment corridors, fortifying its blockchain payments foundations and creating more financial products built on stablecoins. The firm also aims to strengthen the bridge between digital and traditional finance in the Asia region and other emerging markets.
